question: Which of the following organisations successfully conducted the first flight trial of a stratospheric airship platform at Sheopur, Madhya Pradesh, to enhance military surveillance capabilities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully conducted the first flight trial of a stratospheric airship platform at Sheopur, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• This airship platform is designed to enhance military surveillance capabilities, offering a high-altitude, persistent solution for monitoring activities over a wide area.
 
• The stratospheric airship is equipped with advanced sensors and communication systems to provide real-time intelligence and situational awareness to the armed forces.</li
